description: This Java source file defines a JUnit test case class 'InvoiceTestCase' which automates the creation of an invoice PDF for an order within a sales management system. It includes setup of product options, customer data, order details, and generates an invoice document including spreadsheet manipulation and PDF rendering.

classes.name: InvoiceTestCase
classes.description: JUnit test case class extending core test case, responsible for creating and generating invoice PDFs for orders.

methods.name: createInvoice
methods.description: Test method that constructs product, customer, order data, populates an ODS spreadsheet template with invoice info, and renders a PDF invoice document.
